proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: Full read of the restated block (issue #8893). Matches: pairSkein s a b = (q a + q^-1 b)/(s+s^-1) with q = s^2 is the pair Skein formula; protonMass/neutronMass are the .md sums.

Lean matches (i) exactly (neutron_sub_proton, no hypotheses) and matches the determinant numerator (det_eq) and the inverse formulas (up_eq/down_eq). Two gaps against (ii): (1) the .md says 'each pair (m_p, m_n) comes from exactly one pair (mu_u, mu_d)' and the Scope paragraph rests on 'can always be chosen to fit', i.e. existence/surjectivity; terminal_resolution states only uniqueness (injectivity), and up_eq/down_eq hold only for (m_p, m_n) already in the image. Surjectivity is true over a field and a few lines to prove, but it is not stated. (2) Lean carries hypotheses the .md does not state: s != 0, s + s^-1 != 0 and (3 : K) != 0 besides [2]_q != 0. Harmless for q > 0 real, but the .md's 'whenever [2]_q != 0' is not the Lean's condition (fails in characteristic 3).
